definition: Establishes what the deck is and who is speaking; the first slide of the deck.
sources: research/06 §(b) Layer 1 (PPTAgent structural slides, Google TITLE)

definition: Announces the sections that follow; inserted when the deck has 4 or more sections.
examples: insert when the deck has >= 4 sections (research/06 §(d))

definition: Marks a boundary between top-level parts of the argument.
examples: insert at each top-level heading yielding >= 2 content slides, when the deck has >= 3 sections (research/06 §(d))

definition: Carries the substance: a claim with its evidence, a comparison, a process, a figure.
examples: the default function; roughly 2.4 slides per section (research/06 §(d), DOC2PPT)

definition: Restates the argument of a section or of the whole deck in condensed form.
Ends the deck: the ask, the next steps, the sign-off.
Back-up material kept out of the presented narrative.
